description: The gate set (the model owner's decision of 2026-09-20, Highlights 5.4, record 87 of docs/LOG_2026-09-20.md; chosen by measured coverage on 2026-09-20, the trimming plan, record 91): the worlds replayed at every commit of an integration through tools/run_series.py --list. Together they declare every key, table rule and family kind of the register, write every record kind, and execute every engine line any registered world reaches. The whole register replays only under --full or on demand. A new key or rule adds the first world that declares it, with the line it covers. ticks is the world's declared duration; cap is the interval by which the world's coverage is complete (the fast pass, --list --fast). A world without a lamp carries `digests`: the sha256 of its state.json, of the books (the audit of run.json, JSON-encoded) and of events.jsonl at its cap, the register of the replay's expected bytes that tests/test_amplitude_click.py (d) reads (since 2026-09-21; before, the test's own table): the state's under the fraction-free law of 2026-09-20 (BEAM_LAW note 41), the books and the events the base tree's before the one click, j3_deuteron's moved at the fraction-free stage 1 and again under clock-age-v1 (2026-09-21: its neutrons' clocks count the age moment; the other fifteen worlds byte-identical, no other gate world reads a clock's word).

worlds.covers: the common path: lamp, walk, flight table, collision, phase window, beam pairing, the books

become by the clock (weak-v1), held, lifetime, columns with a sign, a paid family's charge; its neutrons' clocks read the crowd without a word, so its digests moved under clock-age-v1 (2026-09-21, the age moment the clock's default)
action (bohr-v1), phase_by_momentum, charge as a pair, span
a lamp's phase_window, rerelease on declared directions, a wave screen
entity definitions, in_transit, a detector set with a threshold
beam pairing over a large re-emitting set
the lifetime's escape of a crowd, the contact of bound bodies
suspension as a pair, the age moment, a body owing intervals while pushed
a phase-less family's push on the plane
a one-Node re-emitting opening under beam
a body stepping under width with a declared momentum
hand on a family (hand-v1), axis and the right-hand rule in become, the parity filter and the pass by hand, hand on the click, become and face lines, left/right in the books
drive-b-v1 (the world key drive_b, 2026-09-22): the directional drive of a body on the plane diagonal, by_line against the one wall, the escape click on face:+x at tick 101

flow-link-v1 (the world key flow_link, 2026-09-22): the flow label f_D per Euclidean Link in every flow sum (CrowdMoments, optical_turn) on series K's box with the ring of 40 lamps at b = 6 under optical 0; a recorded world (lamps), so no digests; the cap the interval after the first ring row is turned by the crowd under the key (the books' turned line of light first moves at interval 68); the gamma 1 ring is refused by the pair's working bound at d = 16384 (the folder's README), so the gamma 0 ring stands here
